Name: Miska Lake Farm - add or replace plus PIF version
Author: Lykkio
Description:
Miska Lake is the home of an ancient hideaway tucked into the distant backwoods of the mountains, cool and shady during the day with a ghostly green glow at night.

The cave is in the upper left corner, behind a tree. The lake has mountain fish, and you start with 2 cherry and 2 pomegranate trees. Please check the last picture if you need more info.

Neverway and Welcome to Elderfield still don't have release dates (*Neverway got a release date  and a demo and looks awesome!) so I needed to make a slightly ominous map. Plus, the Cherry Lake Tilesheets are just too gorgeous to not play with.

[b]Known issue [PIF only][/b]: The water isn't animating for me in the PIF edition. Not sure yet how to fix it, if anyone knows lmk

Suggested SVE custom warp nexus coordinates: (44, 1) or any coordinate between (37, 1) and (44, 1)
